method: Sunday-morning check before the max-confidence card: tickets rebuilt on a 9:40 AM CT DraftKings/FanDuel pull (data/odds/raw/prekick), then every leg verified against injury reports, role news, main prop lines and kickoff weather by an independent verifier and a skeptic. A ticket the check pulls stays on its game page but is left off the card.
